arms.FAMILY_CERTIFICATE_QUOTIENT: SUCCESSOR: per-family validation + certificate verification with retained witnesses
arms.ORACLE_QUOTIENT: generator-supplied erasure, zero construction cost (upper bound parent)
arms.STRUCTURE_NO_ERASURE: cache keyed on canonical 12-coordinate record (parent control)
arms.SURFACE_HASH_DEDUP: cache keyed on rendered surface string (parent control)
arms.TCSQ_VALIDATED_QUOTIENT: historical per-instance quotient + full-re-solve refusals (strongest classical parent)

claim_boundary: development known-world instrument; one synthetic bounded-planning generator, one hand-registered coordinate schema, one hand-registered intervention family, and a hand-specified operation-count cost model. It does NOT settle whether family-certificate quotients reduce cost on natural problems, with LLM solvers, on unseen coordinate schemas, or under any other distribution. Grants no scientific or method-promotion authority.

cost_model.family_validation: one library materialisation per family (ledger+projection, charged once)
cost_model.maintenance: one solve per re-probed coordinate plus |preserved| re-projection ops per cached entry
cost_model.projection: |preserved| ops per task to form the class key
cost_model.solve: one op per (state, action) transition evaluated by exact BFS
cost_model.verify_refusal_unreachable: a genuinely-unreachable negative has no compact witness -> full re-solve, charged
cost_model.verify_replay: one op per replayed action of a reused certificate

mechanisms.A_per_family_validation: erasure ledger validated once per coordinate-schema family via one assured_materialize_validated_quotient call; per-instance ledger cost amortises to 0
mechanisms.B_certificate_verification: retained witness plans certify over-budget/guard-refused negatives; reused refusals replayed (plan-length ops) not full-re-solved; genuinely-unreachable negatives still full-re-solved
mechanisms.new_dimension_solve_cost_scale: certificate checking is O(plan length), solving is O(states x actions); scaling the state space exposes the reuse-amortisation crossover

net_advantage.note: aggregated across solve_cost_scale x redundancy cells by bootstrap on cell means

negative_subset.description: solve_cost_scale x redundancy cells whose successor net CI excludes zero from below
